answer: A concrete defense is a per-identity capital bond that decays unless the agent earns peer attestations. Registration means locking tokens, and rewards unlock only after independent peers confirm the work. A sybil operator must therefore fund every fake identity separately, and each bond is slashed when attestation fails, so cost scales with the number of identities while returns do not. Cheap identities drain away like water into karst limestone; the honest bond holds like a banked ember, and reputation grows along a vine of verified interactions, one strand at a time.
